evidence.text: Categories: Coffee Shop / Café Stora Bageriet Östermalm SBR Stora Bageriet is located on Östermalm in the oldest industrial building in Stockholm; a bakery that used to supply the military with fresh bread. They're open for breakfast, fika and lunch, and their outdoor terrace is perfect for a refreshing drink in the shade.
